articles.title: 10 Countries Team Up to Build a Giant Invisible Shield Over Europe!
articles.summary: Ukraine and 9 other countries are forming a team to stop dangerous ballistic missiles. They want to use Ukraine’s real battle experience to build a shared defense system for all of Europe.

articles.title: A Real T. rex Named Gus Could Be Yours — If You Have $30 Million!
articles.summary: A huge T. rex skeleton named Gus is up for auction in New York. It’s 38 feet long and could sell for $30 million. The dinosaur was found in South Dakota in 2021.

articles.title: No More U.S. Trips to Cuba? New Rules Freeze Tourism Money!
articles.summary: The U.S. just put sanctions on Cuba's tourism ministry and two big companies. That means American businesses have until August 12 to stop working with them. Over 10 million people in Cuba lost power last Friday.
